reference: bench-src/ref/gen_lensdesign.py — ray-optics 0.9.10 oracle (first-order data, Seidel sums, exact ray refraction, SCHOTT indices) + independent Python for ray aiming, spot RMS, best focus, OPD/Strehl/FFT MTF and a scipy least-squares optimiser
reference_citations: W. T. Welford, Aberrations of Optical Systems, Adam Hilger 1986, ch. 7-9 (paraxial trace, Seidel sums, wavefront aberration on the reference sphere)
J. W. Goodman, Introduction to Fourier Optics, 4th ed., W. H. Freeman 2017, ch. 6 (PSF, OTF as pupil autocorrelation)
M. Hayford, ray-optics 0.9.10, https://github.com/mjhoptics/ray-optics (BSD-3); SCHOTT optical glass catalogue via opticalglass
Thorlabs public catalogue pages (LA1509, LBF254-100, AC254-100-A), read 2026-11-13
tolerance: first-order data 1e-9 relative (entrance-pupil position 1e-6: ray-optics models the infinite object at 1e10 mm); glass indices 2e-6 against the SCHOTT catalogue of ray-optics; Seidel sums 1e-6 relative; real-ray image points 1e-9 mm and directions 1e-12; RMS spots 1e-9 relative; best focus 1e-6 mm; OPD, Strehl and MTF 1e-8 absolute; distortion 1e-8 % and T/S focus 1e-7 mm; F–C focal shift 1e-9 mm; preset claims equal to the reference within 1e-6 and printed within their rounding; optimiser within 0.2 % of scipy least_squares
provenance_note: Expected values were computed by bench-src/ref/gen_lensdesign.py: first-order data, third-order (Seidel) sums and exact real-ray refraction by the ray-optics package (M. Hayford, v0.9.10) with its SCHOTT glass catalogue; chief-ray aiming, pupil grids, RMS spot, best focus (scipy minimize_scalar), OPD on the reference sphere, Strehl, FFT MTF and the optimiser (scipy least_squares, Levenberg-Marquardt) written in Python from W. T. Welford, Aberrations of Optical Systems (1986) and J. W. Goodman, Introduction to Fourier Optics (2017) — not the page code. Since review R-5 (2026-11-13) seven cases reach the same quantities by OTHER methods than the page: on-axis OPD from the transverse ray aberration W = ∫ε dM (4001 meridional rays), RMS and Strehl as continuous pupil integrals, MTF by direct autocorrelation of the pupil function (no FFT), chief-ray aiming by a brentq root on the real stop height, a stigmatic plano-hyperbolic lens (Airy radius 0.61 λ/NA′, Strehl 1, circular-pupil MTF), Seidel W040 against the fitted ρ⁴ term, and Monte Carlo tolerancing (zero tolerances = nominal, index errors keep the dispersion). Still convention-matched (same definitions as the page, not an independent method): ray start plane and secant aiming of the spot/wave/field cases, the 21×21 square pupil grid of the RMS spots, the 64-sample FFT OPD/MTF of the wave cases and the ±0.02 close-ray pairs of the field curves. Prescriptions: Thorlabs public catalogue (LA1509, LBF254-100, AC254-100-A, read 2026-11-13) and the Cooke triplet sample of the ray-optics documentation.
